title: Revenge of the Iron-Blooded Sword Hound
altTitles: Revenge of the Sword Clan's Hound
Return of the Iron-Blooded Sword Hound
description: Vikir was the loyal hound of the ruthless Baskerville family, raised to kill and serve without question. Yet his loyalty was repaid with betrayal and execution. Given an unexpected chance to return to his younger years, Vikir retains all the memories and skills of his previous life. This time, he refuses to remain a disposable hound and begins a ruthless journey to grow stronger, uncover the truth, and take revenge on those who betrayed him.
author: I Stepped on LEGO (레고밟았어)
